problems.note: Rule 4 requires the full-sample AI-versus-comparison effect reported by the paper. Its apparent numerical overlap with the High-constraint simple contrast is a reporting/estimand caveat, not a basis for discarding the printed result under the transcribe-do-not-compute rule. Add the reported main-effect record and preserve that caveat; do not claim that a marginal estimand has been independently verified or calculate replacement statistics. Leave unprinted pooled arm means, SDs and arm counts null. The two cell contrasts do not substitute for this reported main effect.

summary: Checked the 16 requested existing estimates against the extraction rules, codebook, and cited PDF pages. Read all 522 markdown lines, including references, back matter and the appended Reporting Summary. No numerical transcription, participant-count or coding error was confirmed in those 16 records. All 16 p-value alerts are scientific-notation matching false positives, and all nine table-quote alerts are table-layout matching false positives: find_tables() recovers the quoted cells, including the displaced t-test degrees of freedom. All 52 source entries for the checked records match their cited page text or selected Table 1 cells after whitespace normalization. Table 1 supplies the more precise P values for Experiment 3 and the Experiment 4 cell comparisons. The Experiment 4 low-constraint control values are correctly attributed using the Results text despite the mislabeled Table 1 row. Confirmed n_total values are 233 for the checked Experiment 1 outcomes, 200 humans for Experiment 2B, 194 for Experiment 3, 400 for the Experiment 4 expert contrast, and 383 for the Experiment 5 expert contrast. Unprinted arm counts and two-arm totals in Experiment 2A and the factorial cell contrasts are appropriately null. Expert/lay measurement, construct, direction, AI availability, timing, comparison type and between-person coding are supported. Experiment 2B has one idea per human; its participant se_basis is consistent with the codebook, while its output unit and notes retain the mixed human/model error-term caveat. The four factorial cell comparisons cover complete randomized cells; their presence does not replace the two explicitly reported technology main effects. The completeness check found the two missing reported main-effect estimates listed above. No additional eligible contrast could be confirmed from the supplied document beyond those omissions. Separate Supplementary Notes A–K are absent from the supplied PDF and were not found beside the source files; urllib requests to the named OSF project API and then the publisher failed with WinError 10013. Consequently, supplement-only results remain unverified and no values were guessed. No raw extractions, diffs or resolutions were consulted.
